text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature won't be coming here today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the Arima Kinen, she asked Mejiro

McQueen and Mejiro Ryan what makes
them
strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, they've invited her over to learn
the
answer to that question. It's like a
one-day study
abroad program at the
Mejiro's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature is serious about improving,
so I'm
sure she'll come back having
gained something.
Believing that, I wait
for her return.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Darjeeling tea we had just now was
indeed
very different, was it not? You
could tell from the
rich aroma.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No wonder! Everything was done by
hand from
start to finish! Tea masters
really know how to get
the job done.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um... What's going on? Why are we
having a tea
party?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I thought we were going to the training
track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we will. But enjoying some
tea first is
also part of the routine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Routine?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be best to show you
what we
usually do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But it's about time now. Let's hit the
course!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, o-okay!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Welcome back! What's next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...One more lap, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was slower on the tenth lap than
earlier, was I
not?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha! Okay, run until you wanna stop!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huff... Sh-she's so—wheeze—fast!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, welcome back, Nature! McQueen
just took
off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I saw that. She's still going?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She sure is. I don't think she'll be done
for a while
yet. She said she wanted
more speed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She already has so much stamina, but
she wants
even more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen thinks she's not good enough
no matter
how strong she is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's just how high her aim is. And
those lofty
goals keep her going.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her push herself pushes me to do
better
too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm off too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Feeling a bit competitive, huh?
Go get
it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew! I'm done with squats!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, my quads are really feelin' it
today! That's
exactly what I'm talkin'
about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um, Nature is on the floor...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She did an awesome job keeping up!
She's got
guts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I bet she'll be on her feet soon enough.
Do you
mind watching her for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You're going to keep going?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You bet! No way I'm stopping when my
muscles
are just warmin' up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right! Pectoralis major, get ready for
the
workout of your dreams!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No breaks? You're something else,
Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, careful now. How are you
feeling?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, I'm okay. Today's workout was
way
beyond my level, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'd heard Ryan loves working out, but I didn't expect it to be this intense.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's true she loves working out
in and
of itself... But more than that, she
doesn't believe
in her own strength.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, she never stops trying. She
pushes
herself harder and harder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is why I must always aim higher if I
want to
compete with her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for letting me train with you
today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, all we really did was force our
regular
routine on you all day.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's exactly what I wanted!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Today... helped me realized how
closed-off my
world has gotten. I only
ever pay attention to
myself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But you two pay such close attention to
each
other—competing with each other
and taking
note of how strong the other
is.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All I do is envy the strengths of others.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I only notice what I lack... without even

considering what I have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...And so?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll take a better look at the world
around me.
That includes other runners...
and myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's great! I'm sure it'll lead to you
getting even
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um... Can I ask you one more thing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Why did you help me today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Noblesse oblige.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aha! Are you being shy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's because we want to get stronger too.
And we
can do that by competing with a
stronger version
of you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
After all, we're running in the
Takarazuka Kinen
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I like the look in your eyes. Well
then, may
we meet again in Hanshin.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Nice Nature the following day
looking
completely refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat the Mejiros at the
Takarazuka
Kinen!
